attributes.action: Ban the Sale of Fireworks to the General Public to Protect People and Animals
attributes.additional_details: Fireworks are increasingly set off throughout the year, often late at night without warning. This causes distress to pets, horses and wildlife, as well as children and disabled people, particularly those with autism, PTSD, anxiety or sensory sensitivities. Families deserve peace in their homes without unexpected explosions causing fear and sleepless nights. Licensed displays would still allow celebrations while reducing suffering and making communities safer and more considerate for everyone.
attributes.background: Introduce a ban on the unrestricted sale of fireworks to the public. Allow their use at licensed displays only, with any permitted private purchases requiring a licence. Protect animals, children and disabled people from unnecessary noise and distress.

rejection.details:
We have just opened a petition on the subject of banning private sale and use of fireworks, so they can be used only at licensed displays. You may wish to sign this.

Ban the sale and use of fireworks to the general public
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785893
